question:
Select the correct mirror image of the given figure when the mirror is placed at MN as shown.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6afbd9137ade7f75cf0c8385a09a46172dc5ff000366f7225dade170f4031f56.png]
solution:
**Explanation:**

The correct mirror image of the given combination when the mirror is placed at MN is as shown below:-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/19f01ca6cf5c800c50c7dfc5ad6433acfe74952ac3a3161061877548cd7a0116.png] 

__Detailed Explanation__ :- 

__
 
• The line MN is the mirror.
 
• The word [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d2a9fd20f7efcc25a753a47e3534693cf9d8c9a3a35952bf79c31e3791fce68.png] ends with [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0eac7792c159fbb8dc327e0dbabae4e39fa7d942cc5eb873a87fa86d29b8e967.png] . So, the mirror image will start with [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81e54a5a412e8c780fcb1649e97038c4df8a840e89a193bbea8660a3d195fbe3.png] → Options 1, 2, 3 are eliminated.

Hence, Option 4 is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• In a mirror image Left changes to right and the right changes to left where top and bottom remains the same.

 
• When placement of mirror not given, by default we will assume it in vertical direction.
 
• The starting letter word will be at last after the mirror image drawn with left changes to right and right changes to left.
